organizations_limits_effective_hint: For file size, storage and concurrent uploads, the effective value is the smallest of the server default, organization and workspace values.
organizations_retention_effective_hint: For retention periods, use the smaller of the organization and workspace values when both are set, or the set value when only one is set. When neither is set, use the server defaults: 365 days for activity and 730 days for audit logs.
organizations_limit_unset_hint: Not set: uses the server default and organization values.
organizations_limit_exceeds_organization: Must not exceed the organization value.
organizations_limit_bytes_error: Enter a size that converts to a whole number of bytes within range. File size must be positive; storage may be zero.
organizations_limit_integer_error: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
organizations_limits_load_failed: Could not load limits and retention.
organizations_limits_save_failed: Could not save limits and retention.
organizations_limits_unchanged: There are no changes to save.
